pedagogical.evidence: Multi-syllable instruction builds systematic reading habits: "When reading multi-syllable Ukrainian words, keep every unstressed vowel clear and distinct:".
evidence_quotes: When reading multi-syllable Ukrainian words, keep every unstressed vowel clear and distinct:

naturalness.evidence: Dialogue lines demonstrate natural conversational Ukrainian with accurate vocative forms: "Послухайте розмову Олі та Тараса про подорож і фотографії — listen to Olya and Taras talk about travel and photographs:".
evidence_quotes: Послухайте розмову Олі та Тараса про подорож і фотографії — listen to Olya and Taras talk about travel and photographs:

decolonization.evidence: Targeted phonetic guidance prevents Russian vowel reduction and stress transfer habits: "- **Уникати типових пасток наголосу** — master stress in numerals (**одина́дцять**, **чотирна́дцять**), adjectives (**нови́й**, **стари́й**), and names (**Марі́я**);".
evidence_quotes: - **Уникати типових пасток наголосу** — master stress in numerals (**одина́дцять**, **чотирна́дцять**), adjectives (**нови́й**, **стари́й**), and names (**Марі́я**);

engagement.evidence: Multi-sensory triad actively integrates print recognition, motor handwriting, and vocalization: "- **Зошит** (notebook) builds motor memory as you write out the syllables and place the accent mark;".
evidence_quotes: - **Зошит** (notebook) builds motor memory as you write out the syllables and place the accent mark;

tone.evidence: Encouraging educator tone sets realistic expectations without overwhelming beginner students: "For this module, a stress mark is a training wheel. It is not usually printed".
